inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and the market orientation); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus admission to the Nubian Museum); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (that admission plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: Admission to the Nubian Museum (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the base fare
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.
